name: Ananya Kulkarni
text: The Maharashtrian thali tasted exactly like home. Spotless rooms, warm staff, and the river view at sunset is unforgettable.

name: Rahul Mehta
text: Finally a hotel where our Jain family didn't have to ask twice. Every dish was clearly labelled. Highly recommended!

name: Priya Iyer
text: Crispy dosas, perfect filter coffee and a very peaceful stay. Breakfast spread is generous.

name: Sandeep Patil
text: We hosted our daughter's engagement in the banquet hall. Décor, food and service were all top class.

name: Meera Joshi
text: The puran poli with ghee and the aamras are a must. Calm, clean, truly satvik.

name: Vikram Singh
text: Excellent paneer tikka and dal makhani. Business-friendly rooms with fast Wi-Fi.
